project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Mink Ventures Acquires Gambler Project...' and states the company 'has acquired a 100% interest in the Gambler property'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV:MINK) (“MINK” or the "Company") today announced that it has acquired a 100% interest in the Gambler property...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Mink Ventures, is quoted in the text: '“Consolidating claims over 100 km2...is an enviable position for Mink from a both geological and corporate perspective,” said Natasha Dixon, Mink President and CEO.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states: 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV:MINK) (“MINK” or the "Company") today announced that it has acquired a 100% interest in the Gambler property...'

primary_commodity.justification: The article title describes the project as a 'Ni Cu Co Project'. The body also refers to Mink's 'nickel copper cobalt exploration portfolio'.

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable article link was provided in the source document text.

currency.justification: The transaction consideration was a Net Smelter Royalty, not a monetary payment, so no currency is specified.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The consideration for the acquisition did not include cash. The text states: 'Total consideration for the claims is a 2% net smelter return royalty (NSR) on those claims...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration for the acquisition did not include shares. The text states: 'Total consideration for the claims is a 2% net smelter return royalty (NSR) on those claims...'

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration was a royalty, not a combined cash and share payment.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the consideration for the Gambler project acquisition.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no associated share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned for the Gambler project.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment was specified for the Gambler project. A drill program is mentioned for a different project: '...the diamond drill program at Mink’s nearby Warren Ni Cu Co project...'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The consideration for the acquisition was a royalty granted to the seller. 'Total consideration for the claims is a 2% net smelter return royalty (NSR) on those claims, granted in favour of Voltage Metals Corporation.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the area for the Gambler property itself: '...acquired a 100% interest in the Gambler property, consisting of 296 mining cell claims (59.2 km2)...' The larger 100 km2 figure is a combined total with the separate Montcalm property and is therefore ignored.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit is provided in the same sentence as the area measurement: '...the Gambler property, consisting of 296 mining cell claims (59.2 km2)...'

resource_size.justification: No mineral resource has been defined for the Gambler project. The text describes the claims as 'underexplored'. The only resource mentioned is for the adjacent, separate property: '...adjoining the former Glencore Montcalm nickel mine, with historical production of 3.93 million tonnes @ 1.25% Ni, 0.67% Cu and 0.05% Co...'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first sentence of the press release: 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV:MINK)'.
